name: Iverron's Antidote
summary: In Shadowglen, Iverron waits for a cure before the poison takes hold. Webwood spiders have poisoned the night elf scout, and Dirania Silvershine's brew must reach him within five minutes.

sections.title: A Race Against the Clock
sections.body: Dirania Silvershine makes the cure from fresh venom sacs, lily roots, and hyacinth fungi. Once distilled, the unstable brew holds its strength for only five minutes. Carry the vial straight from the glade toward the northern heights, without delay.

sections.title: A Habit of Trouble
sections.body: Webwood spiders near Shadowglen's barrows and caves poisoned Iverron. He admits he often stumbles into danger and relies on Dirania's herbal skill to save him. Even after he drinks the antidote, he remains frail. Hostile spiders still guard his way home, and he fears them.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on delivering the antidote?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine's antidote quickly loses its healing strength because it is made from fresh plants and venom. Iverron must drink it within five minutes of its leaving her care.
Iverron waits against the rocks outside Shadowglen's northern cave, north of the grove's main path.
Webwood spiders poisoned Iverron. They live on Shadowglen's northern outskirts and have multiplied around Teldrassil's roots and caves.

faq.q: What happens after Iverron drinks the antidote?
faq.answer: The antidote neutralizes the poison, but Iverron remains too weak and shaken to travel safely alone. He asks for help clearing the nearby Webwood spiders that block his way to safety.

faq.q: What relationship do Dirania and Iverron have?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine is an herbalist and healer in Shadowglen who often rescues Iverron from trouble. He admits he keeps getting into danger and Dirania is always helping him out.

faq.q: What happens if the antidote expires before reaching him?
faq.answer: If the brew spoils before reaching Iverron, get a fresh dose from Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen and make the run again.

angles.text: As a young night elf training in Shadowglen, you see Iverron's rescue as a sobering sign of the corruption and aggression stirring among Teldrassil's native wildlife.
As an herbalist, you know raw woodland plants can be hard to work with. Without proper preservation, their brews quickly lose their vital properties.
